title: Integration tests overwrite or delete real environment keys (DASHBOARD_API_KEY, DASHBOARD_PORT, DASHBOARD_HOST, DB_PATH, MID_RUN_CHECK_INTERVAL_SEC, MEV_CONFIRM_*) and clean up by deleting them instead of restoring the previous value; before the rails those were the operator's .env values

evidence.note: sets DASHBOARD_PORT = "0" and DASHBOARD_HOST in each case and never restores them
afterEach deletes DB_PATH although the file never sets it: the real DB_PATH from .env is removed for the rest of the worker
deletes MID_RUN_CHECK_INTERVAL_SEC before and after each case
sets MEV_CONFIRM_WINDOW_MS / MEV_CONFIRM_POLL_MS and deletes them at the end of the case (:323-324), not in a finally

sibling_sites_checked: git grep -n "process.env\.[A-Z_]* =" and "delete process.env" over test/integration at the base SHA: the six files above; risk.test.ts replaces and restores the whole process.env object (sound); mevStrategies.test.ts and txManager.test.ts restore BLOXROUTE_AUTH_HEADER / FLASHBOTS_AUTH_KEY from a saved copy (sound). Unit sibling: AUD-TESTU-015.
severity_rationale: S3: hygiene with a pre-rail side effect (a deleted DB_PATH makes a later in-worker import fall back to cwd/data/bot.db); ordering-dependent behaviour, no direct capital effect.
recommendation: Phase 28: use vi.stubEnv / vi.unstubAllEnvs (or save-and-restore in afterEach) for every env key a test sets or deletes.
